name: cpu-reference
command:
set -e
trap 'echo 1017600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq
echo 4320000 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_max_freq
echo 1017600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq' EXIT
echo 1017600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq
echo 1401600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_max_freq
echo 1401600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq
cd /data/local/tmp/dense-af-multilayer
env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ADSP_LIBRARY_PATH=. GGML_HEXAGON_DEVICES=1 GGML_HEXAGON_PROFILE=0 GGML_HEXAGON_POWER=nom GGML_HEXAGON_DCVS=0 DENSE_AF_CLOCKS=1 timeout 240 taskset c0 ./dense-af-bench -m /data/local/tmp/models/Qwen2.5-3B-2K/ggml/weights.gguf --device CPU --prompt 1 --past 256 --layers all --stage both --flash 1 --threads 2 --warmup 2 --reps 2 --reference reference --write-reference
cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_max_freq
